title: Arranging for Earl Hines and teaching Lil Armstrong to score
summary: Back in Chicago he began arranging and gigging, wrote for Earl Hines's Grand Terrace band and taught scoring to Lil Hardin at his home studio.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Yeah, this was just about the time Earl's band was starting, '29.
Yes, because Earl Hines was at the Grand Terrace then. I started arranging for Earl Hines and then
Louie came back from California and I arranged -- I was teaching Lil -- teaching his wife how to arrange, and she was studying scoring under me. And --
Well, did you set up a studio in your home?
The same sort of set up you have now?
Yeah, the kind of set up like I have here now.
